title: OfacMatch: explainable OFAC sanctions name screening
description:
OfacMatch screens person, company, vessel and aircraft names against the U.S. Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list and explains every potential match, combining whole-name and name-part comparison (Jaro-Winkler similarity and Soundex) on OFAC's 0-100 scale. It flags date-of-birth and country conflicts, runs locally, and is evaluated on the real SDN list: at a threshold of 85 it finds 99.8% of 4,255 realistic variations of listed names.

Available as a .NET library (NuGet: OfacMatch), an MCP server for AI assistants (NuGet: OfacMatch.Mcp) and a browser-based demonstration at https://krunalsolanki.github.io/ofac-match/.
